vendored.name: superpowers
vendored.notes: All 14 skills copied verbatim with the repo's own .claude-plugin/plugin.json. hooks/, assets/, docs/, scripts/, tests/, and other-platform (.codex-plugin/, .cursor-plugin/, etc.) directories stripped.

vendored.name: ponytail
vendored.notes: Source repo has no .claude-plugin/plugin.json (uses a root-level plugin.json + plugin.yaml for a different, multi-platform packaging convention) -- a minimal .claude-plugin/plugin.json wrapper was authored fresh for this vendored copy (not a patch to skill content). commands/ (TOML format, not Claude Code's .md convention) and hooks/ were not vendored -- unvalidated mechanisms; the plugin_directories -> skill-loading path is what Phase A0 actually confirmed works. ponytail-mcp/ (a bundled MCP server) was also not vendored -- flagged as a future enhancement, not validated here.

vendored.name: caveman
vendored.notes: Only the caveman skill itself was vendored, per explicit direction -- the source repo is a large monorepo (browser extension, proxy server, compression engine, MCP server, multiple other caveman-* skills). LICENSING.md confirms skills/ is MIT while the engine/proxy/browse/mcp components are BSL-1.1 -- vendoring only the skill keeps this cleanly within the MIT-licensed surface. No .claude-plugin/plugin.json in source; wrapper authored fresh, same reasoning as ponytail.

vendored.name: security-review
vendored.notes: Skill + its references/ subfolder (bundled reference docs, a legitimate skill component) copied verbatim. No .claude-plugin/plugin.json in source (it's one skill among many in a shared collection repo); wrapper authored fresh.

vendored.name: impeccable
vendored.notes: Apache-2.0 (LICENSE + NOTICE.md copied to the plugin root per Apache attribution requirement). Source repo ships an official Claude plugin at plugin/ (v4.1.1); its .claude-plugin/plugin.json and skills/impeccable payload copied. Stripped as interactive/unvalidated in a headless pipeline: scripts/live* + scripts/live/ + live-browser*.js, reference/live.md, reference/live-setup.md, scripts/hook*.mjs, reference/hooks.md; the SKILL.md rows/paragraphs referencing them (live command row, Hooks paragraph, 'live' in argument-hint) were deleted so no instruction points at a stripped file. Patched: every '.claude/skills/impeccable' script-path fallback in SKILL.md and reference/*.md rewritten to the absolute in-container path /opt/ai-dev-workflow-plugins/vendor/pbakaus-impeccable/impeccable/skills/impeccable (Copilot CLI does not reliably report a skill base dir the way Claude Code does). scripts/ left byte-identical (they resolve their own paths relative to the module; the update check fails silently offline). Used by graph.py's UI-repo-gated prompt segments: shape (P3, methodology only), design rules + document (P6), critique (P11a), audit detectors + polish (P11b).
